method.description: Attempted official download of the five Minnesota expungement forms, followed by precise characterisation of what refused the request. The recorded block was re-tested rather than carried forward as an assertion, and the refusing layer was identified from response headers rather than inferred from the status code alone.
method.assignmentConstraintObserved: The stop condition requires preserving the 403/WAF or automation-blocked disposition distinctly, recording attended-retrieval evidence only, and never relabelling the source as generically missing or inferring an alternative. The block is characterised to the mitigation layer and the challenge type. No source is relabelled missing — all five are retained and adopted. No alternative is inferred and no mirror is substituted.

distinctFrom.notAMissingSource: All five documents are retained in this repository and manifested by the adopted edition. Nothing is missing.
distinctFrom.notAWithdrawnPage: The form index is still indexed live and the queue records that no renumbering or supersession was found.
distinctFrom.notAUserAgentFilter: The identical 403 is returned to a default automated client and to an ordinary browser user-agent string. Changing the user agent changes nothing, which rules out simple agent filtering.
distinctFrom.notAnUnreachableHost: The host resolves and completes a TLS connection and returns a well-formed HTTP response. This is the opposite of the Montana case, where courts.mt.gov did not accept a connection at all.
distinctFrom.notAServerErrorOrOutage: A challenge page is served deliberately, with challenge-specific headers.

evidence.decisiveHeaderMeaning: Cloudflare states in the response itself that the request was mitigated by a challenge. This is the issuer's edge provider declaring the refusal, not an inference from a status code.
evidence.challengeType: interstitial managed challenge requiring browser JavaScript execution

blockCharacterisation.recordedBlockText: mncourts.gov returns HTTP 403 to automated retrieval on every URL pattern tried, so the printed revision could not be re-confirmed.
blockCharacterisation.reconfirmationValue: The recorded position was tested rather than assumed, and it holds. It is now characterised one level deeper than before: the refusing layer is Cloudflare, the mitigation is a managed challenge, and the challenge is JavaScript-gated rather than agent-gated. That distinction determines the remedy.
blockCharacterisation.remedy: A rendered-browser session that executes the challenge. This is an attended retrieval and it is the only legitimate route.
whatWasNotDone: No attempt was made to solve, bypass, replay or otherwise defeat the Cloudflare challenge.
No user agent was spoofed beyond an ordinary browser string, and doing so changed nothing in any case.
No mirror, aggregator, cached copy or third-party reproduction was retrieved in place of the issuer.
No alternative source was inferred for any of the five identities.
No archived capture was promoted to a current source.

The equivalent collapse was found and recorded for Florida's Rule 3.989 order identity, which stands for two mutually exclusive orders; Minnesota has correctly kept them apart and that must be preserved.

sourceMaterializationEligibility.laterMaterializationPermittedDetail: Not while currentness is unestablished. All five are source_gated, and materializing them would carry five unverified revisions into the runtime contract for three tracks.
prerequisitesInOrder: 1. Retrieve the five forms through a rendered-browser session that passes the Cloudflare challenge.
2. Read the printed revision from each face, or record affirmatively that a face carries none.
3. Compare the retrieved bytes against the retained digests to settle currentness.
4. Clear the source gate if the comparison holds, and reclass from source_gated.
5. Only then author receipts with destinations under official-pdf/MN/.

implementationFamilyEffect.effectOfThisJob: This job is one of two open dependencies of rcap-mn-flat-pdf-overlay, which covers three Minnesota tracks; the other is the in-repository reconciliation, which is complete and integrated. It does not release that job, because the currentness question it exists to answer is answerable only by an attended retrieval. What it contributes is a block characterised to the mitigation layer, a precise statement of what is and is not withheld, and a named remedy.
implementationFamilyEffect.familyReadinessStatement: The Minnesota official-PDF family remains fail-closed and this job does not move it. All five assets stay source_gated at REV-UNKNOWN with runtime disabled, the sibling FEE102 asset-class defect is unrepaired, generation is not permitted, and no field map is built. No packet becomes generatable and no renderer is assigned.
implementationFamilyEffect.netEffectOnBlockers: One blocker is characterised rather than cleared, and the remedy is narrowed from an open acquisition to a single attended session covering five documents at one index URL.

terminalDispositionDetail.why: The narrowest disposition the evidence supports. It is not unresolved_identity: all five documents, titles, roles, issuer and statutory routes are established. It is not source_missing, which the stop condition expressly forbids and which would be false — every one of the five is retained and manifested. It is not a host outage: the server answers, and answers with a challenge that names itself in the response headers. What is blocked is one axis, currentness, and the remedy is an attended session.

expectedDownstreamEffect: The Minnesota source gate stays open and its cause is now characterised precisely: a Cloudflare managed challenge that declares itself in a cf-mitigated response header, returns HTTP 403 identically to automated and browser clients, and covers the site root as well as the form index. The remedy is named — one rendered-browser session covering all five documents at a single index URL — and the distinction from the Montana case, where the host accepts no connection at all, is recorded so the two are not treated as one kind of problem. All five identities are affirmatively confirmed retained and adopted rather than missing, which is the relabelling the assignment forbids. Ten component bindings across three tracks are confirmed correct. No binary is acquired, no receipt is created, nothing enters version control, no alternative is inferred, no mirror is substituted, no component is rebound, no memo is edited, no edition is published, no packet becomes generatable, no runtime is enabled and no track changes promotion state.
